concepts.name: tile
concepts.definition: One glass card on the home page bento grid that renders one data source or one piece of profile copy, in one hue.

concepts.name: collector
concepts.definition: The Spotify collector service on vinelab that stores every play in SQLite and publishes yearly stats and the live key to Redis.

concepts.name: view
concepts.definition: The plain object a pure module in app/lib builds from a route payload for one tile to render.

concepts.name: snapshot
concepts.definition: A precomputed payload in Redis that a local importer or the collector writes and a route only reads.

concepts.name: live key
concepts.definition: The Redis key spotify:live that holds the minutes and streams of the current calendar year.

concepts.name: headline
concepts.definition: The one large number a data tile leads with, sized by HEADLINE in accents.mjs.

concepts.name: tier
concepts.definition: One of the six Obsidian task lanes, now, next, waiting, blocked, someday and backlog, each with one hue.

concepts.name: archive
concepts.definition: The Spotify extended streaming history export, read by importArchive from Streaming_History_Audio files.

concepts.name: dedupe key
concepts.definition: The play timestamp truncated to the second plus the track URI, or track and artist when no URI exists.

concepts.name: play
concepts.definition: One listen of one track, stored as one row in the collector database.

concepts.name: staging
concepts.definition: The integration branch that every feature branch targets before a release reaches main.
